name: When should I hire a federal criminal defense attorney?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a federal criminal defense attorney?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should hire a federal criminal defense attorney as soon as you suspect you are under investigation or immediately after being contacted by federal agents—early intervention can prevent charges or protect your rights.heathhydelawyer​
